vocabulary.meaning_en: to be the person who controls or manages something
vocabulary.example: Anna is in charge while the manager is away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do a more senior person's job for a short time
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يقوم مؤقتًا بعمل شخص أعلى منصبًا
vocabulary.note_ar: act up لها معنى آخر: يُسيء التصرف (للأطفال أو الأجهزة).
vocabulary.note_en: It can also mean 'behave badly' (children, machines).
vocabulary.example: Can you act up as team leader next week?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person who manages you at work
vocabulary.example: My boss gave me a new project.

vocabulary.meaning_en: always telling other people what to do, in an unpleasant way
vocabulary.example: Try to be firm, but not bossy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take control of a situation
vocabulary.example: When the boss was ill, she took charge.

vocabulary.meaning_en: friendly and easy to talk to
vocabulary.example: Our manager is very approachable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a problem or worry
vocabulary.example: If you have any issues, please tell me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a move to a higher job
vocabulary.example: Congratulations on your promotion!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a book or calendar for writing appointments
vocabulary.example: Let me check my diary for Tuesday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: office paperwork and organising tasks (short for administration)
vocabulary.example: I spend every morning doing admin.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to send a phone call to another person's phone
vocabulary.example: Could you transfer the call to the sales team?

vocabulary.meaning_en: strict, but treating people equally and reasonably
vocabulary.example: A good manager is firm but fair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stay calm in a difficult situation
vocabulary.example: She kept her cool when the customer shouted.

vocabulary.meaning_en: work continues normally
vocabulary.example: The boss is away, but it's business as usual.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have a short private talk with someone
vocabulary.example: Could I have a word with you in my office?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to talk about something in detail
vocabulary.note_ar: لا نقول discuss about، بل discuss something مباشرة.
vocabulary.example: Let's discuss the plan at the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when people come together to talk about work
vocabulary.example: The meeting starts at ten.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to relax and not work, to get better
vocabulary.example: The doctor told him to rest for a few days.

vocabulary.meaning_en: you can come and talk to me at any time
vocabulary.example: If you have questions, my door is always open.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where sick or injured people are treated
vocabulary.note_ar: البريطانيون يقولون in hospital، والأمريكيون in the hospital.
vocabulary.note_en: UK: in hospital; US: in the hospital.
vocabulary.example: He is in hospital after an accident.

vocabulary.meaning_en: words you say when someone has done well
vocabulary.note_ar: تُستخدم دائمًا بصيغة الجمع، وبعدها on.
vocabulary.example: Congratulations on your new job!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give something for money; the job of selling
vocabulary.example: Denise wants to do more selling.

fine_lines.title: boss vs bossy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: boss اسم يعني المدير. bossy صفة سلبية لشخص يحب إصدار الأوامر للآخرين بطريقة مزعجة، حتى لو لم يكن مديرًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A boss is the person in charge (noun). Bossy is a negative adjective for someone who likes telling others what to do.

examples.sentence: Don't be so bossy – ask nicely!

fine_lines.title: in charge vs take charge
fine_lines.explanation_ar: be in charge تصف حالة: أنت المسؤول الآن. take charge تصف فعلًا: تبدأ في تولي المسؤولية والسيطرة على الموقف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Be in charge' is a state (you are the manager now). 'Take charge' is an action (you start controlling the situation).

examples.sentence: Who is in charge of this project?
Somebody needs to take charge and make a decision.

expressions.phrase: If anyone has any issues about their work, please come and speak to me.
expressions.meaning_ar: إذا كانت لدى أي شخص مشكلات في عمله، فليأتِ ويتحدث معي.
expressions.meaning_en: Tell me if you have problems with your work.
expressions.example: If anyone has any issues about the new system, please come and speak to me.

expressions.phrase: I would like to have a meeting to discuss our work.
expressions.meaning_en: I want us to meet and talk about our work.
expressions.example: I would like to have a meeting to discuss the budget.

expressions.phrase: If there is anything you want to ask, my door is always open.
expressions.meaning_ar: إذا أردت أن تسأل عن أي شيء، فبابي مفتوح دائمًا.
expressions.meaning_en: You can come and ask me anything at any time.
expressions.example: Welcome to the team. If there is anything you want to ask, my door is always open.

expressions.phrase: Could you transfer the call, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك تحويل المكالمة من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Please send the phone call to my phone.
expressions.example: Could you transfer the call to my desk, please?

expressions.phrase: Could I have a word in my office, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني التحدث معك قليلًا في مكتبي؟
expressions.meaning_en: I want to talk to you privately.
expressions.example: Tom, could I have a word in my office, please?
The manager is ill, but it's business as usual.

expressions.meaning_en: Well done on getting a higher job.

expressions.example: Sorry to hear you're ill. Get better soon.

grammar.title: If + present simple + instruction (polite offers and instructions)
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم If + المضارع البسيط، ثم أمرًا أو جملة بالمضارع: If you have any issues, (please) come and speak to me. هذا أسلوب مهذب ليقول المدير للموظفين ما يمكنهم فعله.
grammar.explanation_en: Use If + present simple, then an imperative or a present sentence. Managers use it to give polite instructions.
examples: If anyone has any issues, please come and speak to me.
If there is anything you want to ask, my door is always open.
If you need help, call me.

grammar.title: I would like to + verb (formal wish)
grammar.explanation_ar: I would like to (I'd like to) أكثر تهذيبًا ورسمية من I want to، وتُستخدم في العمل لإعلان الخطط.
grammar.explanation_en: 'I would like to' is more polite and formal than 'I want to'.
examples: I would like to have a meeting to discuss our work.
I'd like to introduce our new manager.
We would like to thank you all.

grammar.title: anyone / anything in questions and 'if' sentences
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم anyone و anything بعد if وفي الأسئلة والنفي، ونستخدم someone و something في الجمل المثبتة غالبًا.
grammar.explanation_en: Use anyone and anything after 'if', in questions and negatives; use someone/something in positive sentences.
examples: If anyone has any issues, speak to me.
Is there anything you want to ask?

questions.question: Paul asks Anna to 'act up'. What does he mean?
choices: do his job for a short time
questions.explanation_ar: act up في العمل تعني القيام بعمل مدير أعلى مؤقتًا.
questions.explanation_en: At work, act up means doing a senior person's job for a while.

questions.question: If anyone ___ any issues, please come and speak to me.
Which word describes a friendly manager who is easy to talk to?
questions.explanation_ar: approachable تعني ودود يسهل التحدث إليه.
questions.explanation_en: Approachable means easy to talk to.

questions.question: 'My door is always open' means ___.
choices: I never close my office door
you can come and talk to me any time
questions.explanation_ar: تعبير يعني أنك مرحَّب بك للحديث معي في أي وقت.
questions.explanation_en: It means you are welcome to talk to me any time.

questions.question: I would like ___ a meeting to discuss our work.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد would like نستخدم to + الفعل.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_en: Discuss takes an object directly, no 'about'.

questions.question: 'Could I have a word?' means ___.
choices: Can I talk to you for a short time?
questions.explanation_ar: have a word تعني حديثًا قصيرًا.

questions.question: A good boss is firm but ___.
questions.explanation_ar: firm but fair حازم لكن عادل.
